mapper.select: SELECT powtoon_group_code, name, powtoon_parent_group_code, master_id, created_time, updated_time FROM groups JOIN user_groups ON groups.powtoon_group_code = user_groups.powtoon_group_code AND user_groups.user_id = #{userId} JOIN user_managed_groups ON groups.powtoon_group_code = user_managed_groups.powtoon_group_code AND user_managed_groups.user_id = #{userId} WHERE master_id = #{masterId}
